name: core-approvals
description: Approvals, the core's sign-offs on the moves of the type's Workflow (D56): the gate on a transition, signOff with its permission and its vetoes, withdrawSignOff, the creator's exclusion and from, the Approvals.gates field and its events, what consumes a sign-off (a change of the own fields, an update's or an operation's update(), and entering the gated state, whoever moves it), listSignOffs, its config, its rule for a new version, deletes and its guidance. Lease beside it is in the work-queue package's lease-approvals test.

s9.name: Workflow
s9.description: A state machine on the instance: a status that starts in the initial state and changes only through transition, along a transition the config lists. A transition may name a permission the caller must hold. A state that no transition leaves is terminal, and a terminal state has an outcome: success, failure or neutral, success unless the config says otherwise. Other instances' blockers, rollups and reactions read it.
s9.summary: Its status is one of draft, review, approved and published; a new Doc starts in draft, and status moves only by transition. Terminal, with their outcomes: published (success).

vetoes.description: The instance is already in the state the transition names.
The instance is in a terminal state: no transition leaves it.

The instance has no status to move from.

shared.s10: Sign-offs that gate states of the type's Workflow. A transition into a gated state, from a state its gate allows, waits until as many distinct principals holding the gate's permission as its count have signed off; the instance's creator cannot sign unless the gate allows it. A change of the instance's own fields consumes every gate's sign-offs, unless the config keeps them, and entering a gated state consumes that gate's, so a return to it signs again. Consumed sign-offs stay listed. Deleting the instance deletes its sign-offs.

s11.description: A transition into a gated state, from a state its gate allows, with fewer sign-offs than its count; details give the state, the count required and the sign-offs it has.
signOff by a caller whose sign-off for the state is not yet consumed.
signOff by the principal who created the instance, on a gate that excludes the creator.
signOff while the instance is in the gated state.
signOff or withdrawSignOff for a state the config does not gate.
withdrawSignOff by a caller with no sign-off for the state that is not yet consumed.

behaviors.name: Approvals
behaviors.summary: A move into approved waits for 2 sign-offs by callers with permission docs.approve; a move into published from approved waits for 1 sign-off by callers with permission docs.publish. The principal who created a Doc cannot sign off on it. behaviors.Approvals.gates lists the sign-offs that count, by state. A change of the own fields consumes every sign-off, and entering a gated state consumes its own, so each is signed again after.

behaviors.summary: Each Doc holds a thread of comments, each one a reply to another of its comments or not; commentCount counts them.

operations.name: create
operations.title: Create Doc
operations.description: Creates a Doc: validates the instance, data, against the schema's live version and stores it under id, or under a new id when none is given.

guidance.useWhen: Use to create a new Doc: data holds its own fields, and id names it, or the engine makes one.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to change one that exists; call update.
guidance.success: Returns the new instance with its id, its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name. A new instance's status is draft.

operations.name: get
operations.title: Get Doc
operations.description: Returns the Doc with the id: its own fields in data, its behaviors' in behaviors.

valueRefs.description: Return each field the value store holds as its ref, { "$value": <hash>, "bytes": <n> }, listed in valueRefs, rather than its value, which get_value reads

guidance.useWhen: Use when you have the id of the Doc to read.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to find Doc instances; call list.
guidance.success: Returns the instance with its seq, its own fields in data and its behaviors' fields in behaviors, by behavior name.

operations.name: list
operations.title: List Doc
operations.description: Lists Doc instances in creation order, a page at a time: pass a page's next as cursor for the page after it. where keeps the instances whose fields hold the values it gives, a list meaning any of them; a filtered page can hold fewer than limit while next is not null.

next.description: The next page's cursor; null after the last page

operations.name: update
operations.title: Update Doc
operations.description: Applies a JSON merge patch (RFC 7386) to the Doc with the id: a member replaces the instance's, a nested object merges and null removes a member. With expectedSeq the update is refused unless the instance is still at that sequence.

guidance.useWhen: Use to change the own fields of the Doc with the id, as a JSON merge patch; with expectedSeq, the update is refused if the instance changed since that seq.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use to set a behavior's field: the patch holds own fields only, and a behavior's fields change only through its operations. Do not use to move Workflow's status, which behaviors.Workflow holds; call transition.
guidance.success: Returns the instance as the patch left it, with its next seq. A change of the own fields consumes every sign-off: each gate is signed again before its move.

operations.name: transition
operations.title: Doc: transition
operations.description: Moves the instance to another state along a transition the config lists. A transition that names a permission needs a caller who holds it.

from.description: The state the instance was in.

to.description: The state it is in now.

guidance.useWhen: Use to move status from draft to review; from review to draft, approved or published; from approved to review or published.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use from published: no transition leaves a terminal state. Do not use to stay where the instance is. Read behaviors.Approvals.gates before a move: a move into approved waits for 2 sign-offs by callers with permission docs.approve; a move into published from approved waits for 1 sign-off by callers with permission docs.publish.
guidance.success: Returns from and to; status holds to from then on, and enteredAt the time of the move.

operations.name: signOff
operations.title: Doc: signOff
operations.description: Signs off on the instance for a gated state, as the caller. Needs the gate's permission; refused for the instance's creator unless the gate allows it, while the instance is in the state, and for a caller whose sign-off for the state is not yet consumed.

guidance.useWhen: Use to sign off for approved or published, as the caller; it needs the gate's permission, else the call is forbidden.
guidance.doNotUseWhen: Do not use while the instance is in the state, or to sign twice.
guidance.success: Returns the sign-off, the subjects whose sign-offs for the state count (signedBy) and the count the gate needs.

errors.description: Approvals: signOff or withdrawSignOff for a state the config does not gate.
errors.commonCorrection: Name a gated state: approved or published.

errors.description: Approvals: signOff while the instance is in the gated state.
errors.commonCorrection: Wait until the instance has left the state; a sign-off counts toward the next move into it.

errors.description: Approvals: signOff by the principal who created the instance, on a gate that excludes the creator.
errors.commonCorrection: Ask another principal with the permission to sign off.

errors.description: Approvals: signOff by a caller whose sign-off for the state is not yet consumed.
errors.commonCorrection: Leave it: the caller has signed off for the state already.

operations.title: Doc: withdrawSignOff
operations.description: Withdraws the caller's sign-off for a gated state, one not yet consumed.

subject.description: The subject of the caller who signed.

guidance.useWhen: Use to take back the caller's own sign-off for a gated state before the move it waits for.
guidance.success: Returns the sign-off withdrawn; it no longer counts.

errors.description: Approvals: signOff or withdrawSignOff for a state the config does not gate.

errors.description: Approvals: withdrawSignOff by a caller with no sign-off for the state that is not yet consumed.
errors.commonCorrection: None: the caller has no sign-off for the state that counts.
